design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 0. Round 1 authored 2026-09-25; rework round 2 for audit revision 1 on 2026-09-25.
[Rework log]
  F1 (undeclared timeliness overrides): P1 now also overwrites cancellation_timing s7 and appointment_reschedule's hours parenthetical. This task still books and moves nothing.
  F2 (window anchor): P2/P3 windows now end on the day the fee is decided / the refund date, which is what the compute does.
  F3 (rate ladders labelled method): the rate ladders are relabelled parameter. The honest methods are:
    - P1: the preparation-day anchor;
    - P2/P3: a preparation-day anchor for the notice counted for the fee;
    - P4: the unpaid-balance selection rule (active plan: balance less the plan remainder; hardship approval: balance reduced by the percentage; otherwise the whole balance).
  F4 (unreal tiers): the unpaid-balance surcharge and deposit-size credit on the fee are removed. Multi-source now comes from the attendance escalation, which reads two ledger categories (no-show and late-cancellation charges).
  T0-O3: the Self-Pay tier on 2026-08-28 is now also evidenced by the ledger's 2026-07-18 self_pay_visit charge, cited in the contract; the self-pay persona line is listed in required_user_inputs.
  T0-O4: the near-miss is now described as '12 months and 8 days back'.
  World: the consult moves to 2026-10-01, confirmed 2026-09-20. A 50.00 balance was collected at the patient's 2026-09-01 move, per the moved-visit rule. A 3-month payment plan was added (133.33 remaining) with its enrolled charge and first installment.
  Gold: late / 47.50 / 125.00 / 350.00.
[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 0 -> prerequisite_problems=3, factor_counts=[5, 4, 4, 5]. Taken as: cancellation timing 5, booking deposit 5, late-cancel fee prohibition 4, deposit refund 4 (the prohibition and the refund mirror the same four fee ladders).
[Scope] Task 0 claims appointment_ext_cancellation_notice_days, appointment_ext_late_cancel_fee_prohibition, appointment_ext_self_pay_booking_deposit (owner=user) and appointment_ext_late_cancel_deposit_refund, with their four tools. Task 1 keeps the no-show prohibition, the missed-visit refund and the moved-visit balance.
[Why a good test] The customer says only that she can't make her 2026-10-01 dermatology consult and wants her deposit back. The refund rule sends the agent through four decisions:
  (a) The refund waits on the visit's late-cancellation fee decision, which waits on the visit being cancelled with a timing class.
  (b) The timing comes from a five-factor notice rule. Eight calendar days is late for this patient: the preparation anchor, one fee in 12 months, a move 22 days ago, a 49-day lead and a confirmation 3 days ago.
  (c) Medicaid Managed Care has been effective since 2026-09-01, so the fee is recorded as prohibited, for a four-factor amount.
  (d) Her open physical, booked on the Self-Pay tier on 2026-08-28, holds no deposit, so she pays a five-factor booking deposit first. Its balance selection subtracts the balance remaining on her active payment plan.
[Problem tree card] Root appointment_ext_late_cancel_deposit_refund. Topological order: cancellation -> prohibition -> booking-deposit payment -> refund; the payment commutes with the first two. There are 2 value_input edges (the floor for 3 prerequisites is 2).
  Edge 1: fee prohibition -> cancellation. value_input, gate lf_is_late. Sentence: 'The late-cancellation fee the visit carries is fixed only after the visit's appointment record shows it cancelled with a timing class.' False at the opening: 261defee-4a97-47d2-ab51-68f3d009b789.status is booked and cancel_timing is not_cancelled. The only writer is P1's tool.
  Edge 2: refund -> fee prohibition. value_input, gate fee_recorded_as_waived. Sentence: 'The deposit refund on a late-cancelled visit is fixed only after the visit's fee and deposit history shows the decision on its late-cancellation fee.' False at the opening: the visit's history holds only c381471a-cf23-44ef-98bb-12ff65b2c6c9 and 62171759-2acc-41d2-8810-684e66ad2ca9. The only writer is P2's tool.
  Edge 3: refund -> booking deposit. state_gate. Sentence (negated): 'A deposit on a late-cancelled visit is not refunded until each open visit the patient booked on the Self-Pay Account tier shows a booking deposit collected on it.' False at the opening: ae062104-a85c-4fe9-b3c3-08ae62a92d9a holds 0.00. The only writer is P4's user tool (P7 applies only to a visit already holding a deposit).
  Deletion sensitivity (sens.py): skipping the cancellation makes the prohibition 0.0. Skipping the prohibition makes the refund 302.5. Skipping the payment leaves the refund at 350.0, but the 125.00 entry is missing from the terminal state.
[Four-point test] Each sentence uses an ordering connective ('only after', or 'not ... until') and waits on a record-visible state. None names a tool, id or code token. Each is a hard requirement scoped to one visit, or to every open self-pay-booked visit. P3's first sentence no longer restates edge 1 in action form.
[Factor card] (tier taken -> figure when that factor alone is set to baseline)
  P1: anchor 1-2 prep days (method) -> timely; fee history 1 -> timely; move <=30 days -> timely; lead 30-59 days -> timely; confirmation <=7 days -> timely. All-baseline figure: timely. Gold: late.
  P2: start 5-7 days -> 60.00; anchor (method) -> 41.25; escalation, one kind only (multi-source, billing) -> 40.00; move -> 37.50. All-baseline figure: 40.00. Gold: 47.50.
  P4: history rate x1.5 -> 75.00; lead >=45 days -> 150.00; balance selection with an active plan (method, payplan) -> 150.00; balance amount 25.00 -> 100.00; account age -> 150.00. All-baseline figure: 100.00. Gold: 125.00.
  P3: the same four tiers as P2 -> 337.50 / 356.25 / 357.50 / 360.00. All-baseline figure: 357.50. Gold: 350.00.
  Near-misses: the 2025-09-15 late-cancellation charge, 12 months and 8 days back (excluded); the self_pay_visit charge, which is of another kind and not counted.
  Historical deposits obey the charter: 300.00 on 2026-08-13 (150 x 2, lead 28 days, balance counted 25 -> +25, account age -25); the 50.00 balance on 2026-09-01 (300 + 25 + 25 = 350 against 300 held).
[Base-invariant card]
  cancellation: policy_scope for cancellation_timing and reminders_and_release.
  fee_waived: both fee_waiver gates are superseded by the prohibition overwrites, and applies_to_event_id is empty (no billing trigger).
  deposit_collected: one_deposit is superseded by the moved-visit policy's overwrite; the exam holds no entry at all.
  deposit_released: policy_scope.
  Medicaid on the scheduled date: 2026-09-01 <= 2026-10-01. No time gate.
[Business-object card] The consult 261defee-4a97-47d2-ab51-68f3d009b789 (ENC-14820367) with deposit entries c381471a-cf23-44ef-98bb-12ff65b2c6c9 and 62171759-2acc-41d2-8810-684e66ad2ca9. The exam ae062104-a85c-4fe9-b3c3-08ae62a92d9a (ENC-15073318). The ledger rows (dca522ba-d533-4464-aa7c-cb88ed18a243, b1a9fc2d-82ef-47bb-a6f8-cde2bd11b01b, 952d0d94-c57b-4457-9ccc-61512a6e8018, 20b7f8ad-279a-402f-a9a3-a506bc2971ff, a5c85711-6a89-4c16-b19f-0ec242c6b731) and the plan c29590f4-9d39-4164-897c-3c8d33c54922 feed only the counts, the balance and the balance selection.
[Persona] Marisol is a rushed, friendly clerk who volunteers only the surface request. She gives phone, DOB and MRN only when asked; her insurance, her self-pay months and her plan only when asked. She agrees to cancel only when told, mentions the October physical only if asked, pays its deposit herself only after the agent explains it, and ends the call once the refund amount is confirmed.
[Standard solution] Locate and verify (DOB + MRN). Read the appointments, events, account, ledger and plan. Cancel with timing late. Record the prohibition for 47.50. Hand over the payment of 125.00. Refund 350.00.
[Verification] sens.py handling-time replay: late (all single baselines timely); 47.5 (60.0 / 41.25 / 40.0 / 37.5; all 40.0); 125.0 (75.0 / 150.0 / 150.0 / 100.0 / 150.0; all 100.0); 350.0 (337.5 / 356.25 / 357.5 / 360.0; all 357.5). Edge skips: 0.0, 302.5, 350.0.
[Draft recomputation from visible context] From the prose, docstrings, finder returns and persona alone:
  Timing: 8 - 1 = 7 against 2 + 1 + 2 + 1 + 2 = 8 -> late.
  Prohibition: 30 x 1.25 + 10 = 47.50.
  Booking deposit: 100 x 1.5 - 25 + 25 - 25 = 125.00.
  Refund: 350 - 47.50 + 47.50 = 350.00.
[Known observation] O-SC: the refund equals the deposit held whenever the agent's waiver and offset agree. The discrimination sits in the prohibition amount; the refund's ladders bear weight only under the substitution test.
user_scenario: You are Marisol Delgado, 39, a billing clerk in Columbus who has just started a new job and is calling Linden Ridge's Patient Services Center on a short lunch break; you are friendly but a little rushed and you keep your answers short. You have a dermatology consultation with Dr. Anjali Bhatt at the Dublin clinic on Thursday, October 1 at 10:40 in the morning, which you moved once already and confirmed through the portal last weekend, and you now can't go: your new employer put your mandatory orientation on that whole day, and you do not want to book another dermatology visit for now. When you booked that consult back in August you paid a deposit by card, and a little more when you moved it; you don't remember the exact figures, only that it came to a few hundred dollars, and getting that deposit back is what this call is for. You open with: "I can't make my dermatology appointment on October 1st, and I'd like the deposit I paid for it refunded." You give identifying details only when the agent asks for them: your phone number is 6145551472, your date of birth is March 19, 1987 (1987-03-19), and the medical record number printed on your visit summaries is LR1384025. If the agent asks about insurance, you say you have been on Medicaid through Scioto Valley Health Plan since September 1st, and that for a couple of months before that you were paying for yourself. If the agent asks about a payment plan, you say you have a three-month plan for a video visit from July and paid the first installment on September 5. If the agent tells you the appointment has to be cancelled, you say yes, please cancel it, you are definitely not coming. If the agent brings up a charge for short notice, you just ask whether you will owe anything and accept what the agent tells you the record shows; you do not argue about rules you don't know. You also have a physical with Dr. Brandt in Hilliard on October 19 that you booked yourself in the portal; you never paid anything for it and nothing asked you to, and you mention it only if the agent asks about it. Only if the agent explains that a deposit is owed on that October 19 physical before your refund can go through do you agree to pay it yourself by card; when the agent hands the payment over to you, you pay exactly the amount the agent tells you on that October 19 visit, and you read back the receipt number if you are asked. You never ask for anything beyond the refund. If something the agent says does not match what you remember, you only ask them to double-check it against your records; you never suggest a figure or a step yourself. Once the agent tells you the refund of your dermatology deposit has been issued and for how much, you thank them and end the call.

evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every later read and write needs the patient reference number; it is only reachable from this lookup.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Confirm identity with two details on file: date of birth and medical record number.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Identity must be confirmed before any account detail is discussed or any write is made.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Pull every appointment of the patient: the dermatology consult to cancel (scheduled 2026-10-01, booked 2026-08-13, moved once on 2026-09-01, confirmed 2026-09-20, deposit held 350.00), the open preventive exam booked on 2026-08-28 with no deposit, and the two late-cancelled 2025/2026 visits.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The notice days, every notice rise (move, lead, confirmation), the fee's move addition and the refund's state gate (an open self-pay-booked visit without a booking deposit) rest on these rows.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the fee and deposit history: the consult's 300.00 booking deposit (2026-08-13) and 50.00 balance (2026-09-01), and the two late-cancellation fees assessed on earlier visits; the preventive exam shows no deposit entry.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The deposit held that the refund returns, and the missing booking deposit on the preventive exam, are read here.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the financial account: Medicaid Managed Care Account effective 2026-09-01, unpaid balance 158.33, opened 2021-05-10.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The Medicaid prohibition on the consult's scheduled date, the booking deposit's balance and the account-age credit rest on this row.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the ledger: late-cancellation charges with dates of service 2025-09-15 (12 months and 8 days back, outside the look-back) and 2026-03-17 (inside it), the 2025-10-02 payment, the 2026-07-18 self-pay visit charge (a charge of another kind) and its plan installment.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The notice rise, the fee escalation and the deposit rate count these charges; the self-pay visit charge shows the Self-Pay tier before 2026-09-01.

First half of the unlock/call pair; no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Cancel the 2026-10-01 dermatology consult at the patient's request with timing late.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The deposit on the consult is refunded only once the visit is closed, and the fee decision waits on the cancellation with its timing class; the timing is computed by appointment_ext_cancellation_notice_days.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.appointment_id: (1) value 261defee-4a97-47d2-ab51-68f3d009b789; (2) basis: the tool docstring 'reference number of the in-person appointment being cancelled, read from the appointment list returned by the appointment lookup for this patient' and find_appointments(customer_id) returning row 261defee-4a97-47d2-ab51-68f3d009b789 (Specialist Consultation, dermatology, 2026-10-01 10:40, status booked); (3) uniqueness: it is the only visit on 2026-10-01 in dermatology, the one the patient names; the preventive exam is not the visit she cannot attend, and the two older visits are already cancelled.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.cancel_timing: late: appointment_ext_cancellation_notice_days on the world at step 8. Notice given = 8 calendar days - 1 (preparation anchor) = 7. Notice required = 2 + 1 (one fee in 12 months) + 2 (moved 22 days ago) + 1 (booked 49 days ahead) + 2 (confirmed 3 days ago) = 8. 7 < 8 -> late. The other values: timely needs 7 >= 8; clinic_initiated applies only to clinic cancellations; not_cancelled is never the class of a recorded cancellation.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the late-cancellation fee prohibition tool.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair; no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Record the Medicaid prohibition of the consult's late-cancellation fee for the fee the visit carries.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: appointment_ext_late_cancel_fee_prohibition computes the amount; the refund waits on this fee decision.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.appointment_id: (1) value 261defee-4a97-47d2-ab51-68f3d009b789; (2) basis: the tool docstring 'reference number of the late-cancelled in-person appointment, read from the appointment list returned by the appointment lookup for this patient' and find_appointments(customer_id) returning row 261defee-4a97-47d2-ab51-68f3d009b789 (cancelled late at step 8); (3) uniqueness: the prohibition concerns the fee of the visit just cancelled late; the two earlier late cancellations already carry assessed fees.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount: 47.50 = RND((30.00 x 1.25 + 10.00) x 1, 2): 7 counted days (8 calendar, less the preparation anchor) -> 40.00 - 10.00; one late-cancellation charge and no no-show in the 12 whole months back -> raised by a quarter; moved 22 days before cancelling -> +10.00.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the patient's own booking-deposit payment and hand it to her.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The refund on the late-cancelled consult is not made until the open self-pay-booked preventive exam shows a booking deposit collected; only the patient can pay it.

evaluation_criteria.objective: The patient pays the booking deposit owed on the 2026-10-19 preventive exam.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: appointment_ext_self_pay_booking_deposit computes the amount; it opens the state gate of the refund.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.appointment_id: (1) value ae062104-a85c-4fe9-b3c3-08ae62a92d9a; (2) basis: the tool docstring 'reference number of the patient's open in-person appointment the deposit secures, read from the appointment list returned by the appointment lookup for this patient' and find_appointments(customer_id) returning row ae062104-a85c-4fe9-b3c3-08ae62a92d9a (Annual Preventive Exam, 2026-10-19, booked 2026-08-28, deposit held 0.00); (3) uniqueness: it is the only open visit booked on the Self-Pay tier that holds no booking deposit; the consult holds 350.00 and is cancelled. The agent reads the reference out when handing over the payment.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount: 125.00 = RND(MX(0, 100.00 x 1.5 - 25.00 + 25.00 - 25.00), 2): one fee charge in 12 months -> raised by half; 52-day lead -> -25.00; active plan -> balance counted 158.33 - 133.33 = 25.00 -> +25.00; account 1962 days old -> -25.00.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the deposit refund tool for the late-cancelled visit.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair; no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Refund the deposit on the late-cancelled consult, the customer's request.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: appointment_ext_late_cancel_deposit_refund computes the refund amount at its handling time.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.appointment_id: (1) value 261defee-4a97-47d2-ab51-68f3d009b789; (2) basis: the tool docstring 'reference number of the late-cancelled in-person appointment whose deposit is refunded, read from the appointment list returned by the appointment lookup for this patient' and find_appointments(customer_id) returning row 261defee-4a97-47d2-ab51-68f3d009b789 (cancelled late at step 8, deposit held 350.00); (3) uniqueness: it is the visit whose deposit the patient asks back and the only closed visit holding a deposit.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount: 350.00 = RND(350.00 held (300.00 + 50.00 collected - 0.00 released) - 47.50 fee the refund offsets + 47.50 recorded as waived at step 10, 2).

edges.condition: The visit's appointment record has status cancelled, a cancellation timestamp and a cancel timing of timely, late or clinic initiated.
edges.policy_source: The late-cancellation fee the visit carries is fixed only after the visit's appointment record shows it cancelled with a timing class.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The consult is still open: status booked, no cancellation timestamp, cancel timing not_cancelled.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Step 8 sets status cancelled, cancel_timing late and cancelled_at 2026-09-23 10:20:00 EDT; lf_is_late becomes 1 and the notice for the fee reads 8 calendar days (7 counted), so the fee becomes 47.50 instead of 0.00.

edges.condition: The visit's fee and deposit history carries an entry deciding its late-cancellation fee (a waiver entry for fee type late_cancel_fee).
edges.policy_source: The deposit refund on a late-cancelled visit is fixed only after the visit's fee and deposit history shows the decision on its late-cancellation fee.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The consult's history holds only its two deposit collections; no entry decides a late-cancellation fee.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Step 10 adds a fee-waiver entry of 47.50; fee_recorded_as_waived becomes 47.50 and the refund 350.00 instead of 302.50.

edges.condition: Every open appointment of the patient booked while the financial account was on the Self-Pay Account tier has an appointment_deposit_collected entry in its fee and deposit history.
edges.policy_source: A deposit on a late-cancelled visit is not refunded until each open visit the patient booked on the Self-Pay Account tier shows a booking deposit collected on it.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The Annual Preventive Exam booked 2026-08-28 (before the Medicaid coverage effective 2026-09-01, on the Self-Pay tier shown by the 2026-07-18 self-pay visit charge) is open and holds no deposit entry.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Step 12 adds an appointment_deposit_collected entry of 125.00 on the preventive exam and raises its deposit held to 125.00.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The booking-deposit payment on the preventive exam is the only free write. The cancellation and fee prohibition act on the consult, and each compute reads only its own visit plus the account, ledger and plan, none of which these writes touch. Row ids hash their own arguments. So step 12 may come before step 8, between 8 and 10, or after 10 with the same terminal hash and the same 47.50 / 125.00 (sens.py). The cancellation must precede the prohibition and the prohibition the refund (value inputs); the payment must precede the refund (state gate).

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Without the cancellation, lf_is_late = 0 and the prohibition recomputes to 0.00 instead of 47.50 (sens.py skip run); the consult also stays open.
